# Foglio

> Single-file HTML documentation for any document type. Light, dark, or system. Copy the skeleton, fill slots, keep frozen chrome, follow the writing rules in the recipe.

Read RECIPE.md first. Copy skeleton.html to the output path. Use catalog.html only as a catalog of allowed blocks, not as a required outline. index.html is this project's own page. Put project notes after the recipe so the frozen prefix can be cached.

## Must

- [Recipe](RECIPE.md): protocol, writing, invariants, tokens, catalog, slots
- [Skeleton](skeleton.html): start file, frozen chrome already correct
- [Skill](skills/foglio/SKILL.md): installable agent skill, named invocation
- [Specimen](catalog.html): visual catalog of every allowed block
- [Project page](index.html): Foglio explained, built from the skeleton
